research_question: Is the clean DINOv2-G teacher sufficiently stronger than the current compact verifier to justify teacher-to-student geometry distillation?
teacher_adaptation: fit-only PCA225 followed by writer-LDA and L2 normalization

teacher_student_gap_interpretation.small_gap: teacher minus compact WGC cross-script macro AUC < 0.05
teacher_student_gap_interpretation.useful_gap: 0.05 <= teacher minus compact WGC cross-script macro AUC < 0.08
teacher_student_gap_interpretation.strong_gap: teacher minus compact WGC cross-script macro AUC >= 0.08

distillation_decision.high_priority: Teacher reaches at least 0.87 cross-script macro AUC and exceeds compact WGC by at least 0.08.
distillation_decision.worth_pursuing: Teacher reaches at least 0.82 cross-script macro AUC and exceeds compact WGC by at least 0.05.
distillation_decision.weak_justification: Teacher fails to reach either the useful absolute performance or useful teacher-student gap.
